description: Accepted concise Warm-up and Cooldown with separate preparation timer (REQ-022; AC-C49-01, AC-R022-01, AC-R022-02; JOURNEY-022). On the real /review and /workout routes a Warm-up or Cooldown is the shared PreparationGuide (src/ui/preparation-guide.tsx) over TASK-034's reading (src/state/preparation-guide.ts): the stable title (Warm-up or Cooldown, never section_title), the approximate total time (~N minutes, GEN-06 estimate of the section) and the movement names on separate lines, with no prose and no per-movement sets, reps, load, time or rest, and no illustrated four minutes or three rows. The live workout adds a separate preparation clock (src/state/preparation-clock.ts) in the rest timer's own pattern (CountdownCard): Start / Pause and Add 30s over the guide's own time, distinct from the session, rest, movement and format clocks, sharing the countdown warning, recording nothing, with no Dismiss or substitute hide action. Loading, failed read, no movement left and an absent section keep their meanings; a malformed persisted row is an error. The accepted gallery state /gallery/refinements?state=preparation (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d) draws the routes' own consumers from the actual reading. check-01 proves the routes with in-memory doubles and an injected wall clock; check-02 proves them in the browser at 320 and 390 with a contained synthetic session, keyboard, touch, reduced motion, a failed read and its retry, and a reload. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-022 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/preparation-guide.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false
